IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/3] The intervention had three distinct components: (1) the inclusion of a family education component designed to enhance generalization to real world settings and promote a supportive family environment, (2) the development by the children of a videotape that was shown to the parents during the family education session in which children demonstrated and practiced the skills introduced during each CBT session, and (3) the inclusion of both generic and depression-specific CBT components to provide a means of targeting processes associated with depression as well as processes associated with frequent comorbid symptoms/disorders or life problems or both.
